description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Notice publishing expenditure Budget 2019 of Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content contains the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka's estimated expenditure for 2019, including detailed budget allocations for electricity, petroleum, and water sectors with specific performance goals and outcomes. This falls under public sector financial administration and service planning, which aligns with Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) that cover public service operations, financial matters, and administrative functions of government commissions and agencies.
